envelope.description: The capability and table lookups return every result

body.title: The capability and table lookups return every result
body.summary: Delete the limit and slice cuts of capability-reuse-check (exports, subdirs and files), db-tables-list (asked in the data drivers' complete listing mode) and db-table-describe (KV summary fields and sample keys). A Redis or etcd listing stays a sample reported as sampled and incomplete, and nothing scans a live store's keys.
acceptanceChecks: capability-reuse-check, db-tables-list and db-table-describe return every result, and a complete driver's table listing has no limited entry
A Redis or etcd listing is reported as a sample and incomplete, and no key scan of a live store is made

tests.name: completeness-all-lookups.test.ts: capability-reuse-check, db-tables-list and db-table-describe return every result and a complete driver's table listing has no limited entry
kv-common.test.ts: a Redis or etcd listing is a sample reported incomplete and no key scan is made
